name: mise Open Source Dev Tool Manager
free_limit: MIT-licensed local developer tool/version manager, environment-variable manager and task runner for reproducible development environments, with no vendor-imposed project, command or tool-install quota in the open-source CLI.
watch_out: Installed runtimes and plugins are separate software with their own licenses. Download bandwidth, registries, remote services and CI runners may cost money. mise does not include a hosted build environment.
